title: CPX 520A corn: Yield, Maturity and Characteristics
metaTitle: CPX 520A corn: Yield, Maturity and Characteristics
metaDescription: CPX 520A corn is a yellow hybrid corn variety for Luzon, the Visayas and Mindanao. 7.4 t/ha in trials. See its ratings and traits.
excerpt: CPX 520A corn is a yellow hybrid corn variety. It was registered with the National Seed Industry Council in 1994 as NSIC 1994 Cn 55. Cargill Seeds bred it. Its record notes 7.37 tonnes per hectare on average in the trials.

items: **Yield:** 7.37 tonnes per hectare on average in the trials.
**Recommended for:** Luzon, the Visayas and Mindanao.

blocks.text: How long does it take, and how much does it yield?

Its average yield of 7.37 t/ha matches the average of its group, 7.17. One tonne of shelled corn fills about 20 sacks of 50 kilograms. Trial yields come from well managed plots, so your own will depend on water, fertilizer, pests and timing.

Once you know the day count, anee.io dates every task from each lot's own planting day, with [the growth stages and weather](/features/growth-stages-and-weather) beside it.
Is it resistant to pests and diseases?
No pest or disease ratings are published for this variety. So treat it as untested, and scout every week.

The pests and diseases that hit corn fields most often: [Asian corn borer](/pests/asian-corn-borer), [banded leaf and sheath blight](/diseases/banded-leaf-and-sheath-blight), [Corn downy mildew](/diseases/corn-downy-mildew), [Corn ear rot](/diseases/corn-ear-rot), [Corn earworm](/pests/corn-earworm). Our [pest finder](/pests) and [disease finder](/diseases) help you name what you see.
Where and when to plant CPX 520A corn

It is recommended for Luzon, the Visayas and Mindanao. Start with the color your buyer pays for: yellow corn goes to feed mills, while white and glutinous corn go to the table. Next, pick between a hybrid, which yields more but needs new seed every season, and an open pollinated variety, whose seed you can save. Then match the island group in its recommendation, because trials in Luzon and Mindanao give different winners. Before planting, get the field ready with our guide: [Land preparation for corn](/land-preparation/corn-land-preparation).
